title: Account inactive_since status updated
description: This event occurs when the inactive_since attribute of an account is updated. It is triggered by an account status change, a transaction on the account, when a new account is created under a division/program that has dormancy configured, or for each existing account when a dormancy configuration is created for their division/program.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: ID used to identify the program in the Pismo platform APIs

trigger_reason.title: Trigger Reason
trigger_reason.description: The reason that triggered the inactive_since update on the account.

inactive_since.title: Inactive Since
inactive_since.description: The timestamp indicating when the account became inactive, in UTC format

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: ID used to identify the division in the Pismo platform APIs

division_code.title: Division Code
division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division within your organization

external_account_id.title: External Account ID
external_account_id.description: Custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization. This field is a key that links a Pismo account to your account ID.
